name: bloge-resource-gateway-authoring
description: Open the Resource Gateway visual authoring workspace inside VS Code with encrypted crash recovery.

commands.title: Resource Gateway: Save Recovery and Close

resourceGatewayAuthoring.remoteBaseUrl.description: Optional HTTPS Resource Gateway base URL. HTTP is accepted only for loopback development. Empty uses the offline demo catalog.

resourceGatewayAuthoring.allowAdminProxy.description: Allow the WebView to call /admin endpoints through the host. Keep disabled unless the workspace is trusted and the server is explicitly governed.

resourceGatewayAuthoring.requestTimeoutM.description: Host-side timeout for proxied Resource Gateway requests.

scripts.verify: npm test && npm run prepare:webview && npm run check:webview
